I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team. I said the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co. is unconfirmed and that I won't record it anywhere as fact.

I couldn't confirm or contradict the date. The shared files have no Brackenwater account folder I can open, and #central-team has no earlier mention of the account. I suggested she check the contract or CRM record, or ask her Brackenwater contact to confirm in writing. I also offered to help draft that note.

I didn't use message search, since its results can include conversations Pree can't see.
